artifact_policy: compact public provenance only; raw run directory, model exports, plots, and image-level evidence are not committed
data_root: fastai.URLs.FOOD cache path not recorded in public artifact
data_split_rule: RandomSplitter(valid_pct=0.2 seed=42) over the official Food-101 training split
reserved_test_rule: official Food-101 test split not evaluated during baseline selection
